verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is that connections are peer-to-peer and never pass through Parsec's infrastructure. That covers the media path, not local-network discovery or connecting without an account. The evidence instead points to an account-based login (password, MFA, SSO), and nothing documents LAN host discovery or a serverless, accountless pairing mode, so the peer-to-peer claim is an adjacent feature and not this capability.

support.subject: As a power user, my devices find the host on the local network and connect without an account or a vendor server in between
